dict.string: FreeConnect uses Bluetooth Low Energy to discover nearby iPhone and Android devices and send 100% offline messages without internet or mobile data.
FreeConnect advertises as a local Bluetooth peripheral so nearby iPhone and Android users can connect and chat completely offline.
FreeConnect uses Apple MultipeerConnectivity peer-to-peer networking to send offline messages, voice notes, and files directly to nearby iPhones without internet.
FreeConnect uses the camera to scan offline QR contact cards and QR pairing codes.
FreeConnect uses the microphone to record offline voice messages.
